results.name: Four profiles and legacy aliases are canonical
Only AI receives unit attribute multipliers; catalog and human stay unchanged
Damage scales base plus bonuses before armor and terrain cover
Preview, execution and counterattack agree at both numerical difficulty extremes
Dedicated AA multiplies tuned retaliation once and caps it at attacker HP
All 38 deployed AI models receive the correct maximum HP
Campaign settings tune enemies, including wounded starting units, before intro
Tuning wounded reinforcements is proportional and idempotent without resetting AP
Repair uses instance maxHp and cannot overfill a tuned AI unit
Hell scales only AI initial resources and income, retaining caps
Neutral and AI-owned buildings keep baseline HP and construction prices
Save restoration and repeated exports do not multiply HP or resources again
Legacy training migrates to easy once and challenge to hard without resource changes
Corrupt instance HP and unsupported difficulty versions are rejected
Hard focuses a killable enemy instead of spreading fire
Hard chooses a safer approach than baseline against stationary artillery
Hard production counters observed aircraft with an affordable AA model
Hard invests in energy before fuel-heavy expansion when needed
Decision previews are pure even when obsolete enemy plans exist
Hidden opponent changes do not affect AI command, score or threat summary
Public decision redacts invisible actions and never exposes private scores or threat data
Decision is deterministic and public projection does not re-evaluate or mutate it
All difficulties preserve campaign finite production authorizations
